title: Write-data ECC generation and syndrome checking
summary: Introduced ECC models and error observation across multiple protocol branches in a configurable interconnect testbench.

dates.note: Null boundaries preserve unknown project/rotation dates. Inspected author/committer milestones are identified in evidence; they are not employment, project-start, shipment or acceptance dates.

facts.text: Implemented write-data ECC generation over 32-bit chunks using strobe-masked bytes, positional check bits and overall odd parity in a configurable SystemVerilog testbench model.
Built an ECC checker that reconstructs the encoded message, computes a syndrome and exposes aggregate error, single-bit-location and double-bit error indicators.
Replaced write-data parity model instances with ECC models across AXI/ACE-Lite and AHB testbench interfaces and routed aggregate ECC errors into the existing safety-interrupt observation path.

Michael’s initial integration consumed the aggregate error signal and left detailed diagnostic outputs unconnected. Later strobe fixes, correction-bit vectors and actual correction integration were colleague contributions; full current ECC correction is not solely his.

Source establishes the ECC implementation and intended error classifications, not exhaustive fault correctness, a measured coverage result, current active top-level use or simulator/formal/synthesis acceptance.
